inputs.text: A South Portland parent of three is apologizing to school staff as the district faces cuts of more than 70 positions. Families and dedicated employees shouldn’t be made to carry the burden while school leaders avoid explaining how the money was managed. Before taxpayers are asked to pay more, the district owes them clear answers and responsible stewardship. Asking for more funding can’t be the automatic answer to every shortfall.

output.main_topic: A South Portland parent criticizes school district budget management amid staffing cuts and calls for accountability before more funding is sought.
subtopics: Requests for transparency and responsible stewardship
central_entities: A South Portland parent of three

central_relations.subject: A South Portland parent of three

output.narrative_frame: A parent frames staffing cuts as an accountability problem and argues against seeking more funding without clear answers about money management.
opinions: Families and dedicated employees should not be made to carry the burden of the cuts.
The district should give taxpayers clear answers and demonstrate responsible stewardship before asking them to pay more.
More funding should not be the automatic answer to every shortfall.
